parts.label: Letters
parts.prompt: Encode "Hallo" and the null at the end. One hex byte per line.

fields.label: H
fields.hint: Uppercase H is not the same byte as lowercase h.

traps.hint: That is lowercase h. This letter is uppercase.

fields.label: a
fields.hint: Lowercase letters sit after the uppercase block.

fields.label: l
fields.hint: The word has this letter twice. Same character, same byte.

fields.label: l
fields.hint: The second l uses the same byte as the first l.

fields.label: o
fields.hint: Look up lowercase o. Do not reverse the word.

fields.label: end
fields.hint: A C string ends with a null byte.

parts.label: Sequence
parts.prompt: Write the whole byte sequence in order, including the null at the end.

fields.label: bytes
fields.hint: Keep Hallo in order and end with the null byte.

traps.hint: The letters are there. Add the null byte at the end.
